name: alneas-sitekit-workspace
description: Astro site framework with revision-pinned snapshot builds, typed content contracts, and optional Markdown content management.

scripts.release:check: bun run release:notes && bun run quality:checks && bun run release:registry && bun run test:boundary && bun run verify:public && bun run typecheck:all && bun run docs:check && bun run test:all && bun run test:site-build && bun run test:consumer && bun run test:npm && bun run test:example
scripts.docs:prepare: bun scripts/prepare-docs.mjs && node scripts/package-readme.mjs && bun run schema:generate
scripts.docs:check: bun run test:jsdoc && bun run docs:generated && bun run docs:readmes && bun run build:all && node --test scripts/docs-consumer.test.mjs && node scripts/package-readme.mjs --check && bun scripts/check-docs.mjs
scripts.docs:readmes: node --test scripts/package-readme.test.mjs && node scripts/package-readme.mjs --check && node --test scripts/check-readmes.test.mjs && node scripts/check-readmes.mjs
scripts.docs:generated: node --test scripts/check-generated.test.mjs scripts/generated-integration.test.mjs scripts/ai-documentation.test.mjs scripts/schema-generation.test.mjs && node scripts/check-generated.mjs
scripts.quality:checks: node scripts/quality-gates.mjs secrets:history && node scripts/quality-gates.mjs lint && bun run test:quality && bun run test:release-bundle && bun run test:release-publish && bun run test:release-notes && bun run test:cache
